# RFR Real Estate

> RFR Real Estate & Advisory FZ-LLC is a brokerage and advisory firm that works only in Ras Al Khaimah, UAE. The practice concentrates on Al Marjan Island, Mina Al Arab, Al Hamra Village and Downtown RAK. Clients buy, sell, lease and manage homes, including off-plan launches on Al Marjan Island.

Official website: www.rfrrealestate.com (https://www.rfrrealestate.com/) is the official website of RFR Real Estate & Advisory FZ-LLC ("RFR Real Estate", "RFR"), a licensed real estate brokerage and advisory firm in Ras Al Khaimah, UAE. The firm uses no other domain.

The firm is licensed in Ras Al Khaimah (FZ-LLC; licence number on request). It does not publish a street address. Contact is by phone, WhatsApp or email.

Disambiguation: "RFR Real Estate" here means RFR Real Estate & Advisory FZ-LLC of Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates. It is not RFR Holding, the New York real estate company that also appears in searches for "RFR". The official website is www.rfrrealestate.com; websites with similar names are separate organisations.

Where it works: Ras Al Khaimah is one of the seven emirates of the UAE. Al Marjan Island is a group of four man-made islands off the Al Hamra coast; Al Hamra Village (the Emirate's original master community) and Mina Al Arab (a low-rise lagoon community) are on the coast; Downtown RAK is the city around the corniche. All four are covered by RFR; the firm does not work outside Ras Al Khaimah.

A longer plain-text summary of the firm, areas, listings and off-plan launches is at https://www.rfrrealestate.com/llms-full.txt

## Common questions and the page that answers them

- Which areas does RFR cover? Mainly Al Marjan Island, Mina Al Arab, Al Hamra Village and Downtown RAK. RFR does not work outside Ras Al Khaimah. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/ and https://www.rfrrealestate.com/about
- Can RFR help if I'm buying from abroad? Yes. Many clients live overseas; RFR runs video viewings and can manage the property once bought. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/ and https://www.rfrrealestate.com/about
- Is Ras Al Khaimah a good area for property investment? Often, yes: prices are well below Dubai, the Wynn resort opens in 2027, and beachfront supply is limited. RFR will say if it does not suit a given buyer. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/ and https://www.rfrrealestate.com/market
- Can foreigners buy property in Ras Al Khaimah? Yes, in the designated freehold areas, which Ras Al Khaimah Municipality lists as Al Hamra Village, Mina Al Arab, Al Marjan Island, RAK Central, Julphar Towers, Al Maareedh (plots) and the upcoming Beach District. UAE and GCC nationals can buy anywhere in the Emirate. In Downtown RAK, freehold is limited to designated projects such as Julphar Towers and RAK Central. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/buy-sell-lease, https://www.rfrrealestate.com/areas and https://www.rfrrealestate.com/listings
- Does buying property in Ras Al Khaimah give a Golden Visa? It can: property worth AED 2 million or more can qualify for a UAE Golden Visa, subject to the federal ICP rules at the time you apply. Official pages differ on the term (ICP and RAKEZ describe 10 years; the u.ae portal lists 5 years for real estate investments). RFR does not issue visas or give immigration advice. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/buy-sell-lease and https://www.rfrrealestate.com/market
- What are the best areas to live in Ras Al Khaimah? It depends on how you will use the home: Al Hamra Village for families, golfers and investors who want tenants in place; Mina Al Arab for families who want a quieter, low-rise lagoon community; Al Marjan Island for a resort-led, branded home near the Wynn resort; Downtown RAK for short commutes and the lowest entry prices. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/areas#best-areas
- What does it cost to buy property in Ras Al Khaimah? The buyer pays a registration fee of 2% of the market value to RAK Municipality, plus AED 200 for plan issuance and AED 200 for the title deed; mortgage registration is 0.1% of the loan. Agency commission and developer charges are separate. On an AED 1,000,000 apartment without a mortgage, the buyer's government fees are AED 20,400. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/buy-sell-lease#buying-costs
- What are the steps to buy property in Ras Al Khaimah? Set budget and goal; shortlist an area; view (in person or on video); reserve and sign (MOU for resale, developer SPA for off-plan); get the developer NOC; transfer and register at RAK Municipality and receive the title deed; take handover or let it out. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/buy-sell-lease#steps-to-buy
- Is there tax on property in the UAE? There is no income tax or capital gains tax on property in the UAE; registration fees still apply. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/buy-sell-lease
- What are the risks of buying property in Ras Al Khaimah? Slower price growth than earlier in 2026, more than 34,000 units expected between 2026 and 2030 (CBRE), handover dates that can slip, service charges that vary by building, and rental demand around the new resort that is not yet known. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/market#good-place-to-buy
- How do I get started with RFR? Call, WhatsApp or email +971 58 501 5885 / info@rfrrealestate.com. It is free and there is no commitment. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/buy-sell-lease
- How does RFR screen tenants? ID, visa, income and past landlord references are checked; the owner approves every tenant. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/about
- What is Al Marjan Island like, and what do apartments there cost? Four man-made, coral-shaped islands off the Al Hamra coast in Ras Al Khaimah, where the Wynn resort is due to open in 2027. It is freehold, so foreign buyers can own outright. Studios from about AED 920K; 1-bed rents about AED 65–90K a year; indicative gross yields 6–8%. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/al-marjan-island
- What is Al Hamra Village like, and what does property there cost? Ras Al Khaimah's original master community, with an 18-hole championship golf course, a marina and yacht club, a mall and the deepest rental market in RAK; the closest established community to Al Marjan Island. It is freehold. Apartments from about AED 500K, townhouses and villas AED 1.5–5M; 1-bed rents about AED 45–65K a year; indicative gross yields 7–8.5%. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/al-hamra-village
- What off-plan launches does RFR list? Nine launches on Al Marjan Island, compared by developer, starting price, payment plan and handover date. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/off-plan
- What is Manta Bay and where is it? An off-plan launch by Major Developers on Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah (not Dubai; Dubai airport is about 55 minutes away), studios to 2-bed from AED 1,200,000 on a 50/50 plan, handing over Q4 2026, the earliest handover of the nine launches RFR lists. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/manta-bay
- How do I buy property in Ras Al Khaimah as an investor? Set your budget and goal, shortlist an area, view the property, sign an MOU (resale) or the developer's SPA (off-plan), get the developer's NOC, then transfer and register at RAK Municipality and pay the 2% registration fee. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/ras-al-khaimah-property-investment-guide#how-to-buy
- What does RFR's market note cover? What the Wynn Al Marjan Island opening means for prices, rents and off-plan launches on the island. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/market
- What do property terms like freehold, off-plan, payment plan or service charge mean? A short glossary of Ras Al Khaimah property terms is on the services page. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/services
- Who is RFR Real Estate? RFR Real Estate & Advisory FZ-LLC, a licensed real estate brokerage and advisory firm based in Ras Al Khaimah, UAE, founded by Richard Boswell; it offers sales, leasing, property management, investment advice and off-plan launches. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/about
- Is this RFR's official website, and is it the same company as RFR Holding in New York? Yes, www.rfrrealestate.com is the only official site for RFR Real Estate & Advisory FZ-LLC of Ras Al Khaimah; it is not RFR Holding, the New York real estate company. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/about
